blocks.text: King George Corridor homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

King George Corridor, September 2026. Detached houses: 85 listed at month end and 8 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 131 listed at month end and 27 sold in September, a sales ratio of 21% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 39 sold over 4 months against an average of 86.0 listed, about 8.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 14 sold. Condos and townhomes: 89 sold over 4 months against an average of 138.5 listed, about 6.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 27 sold.
